out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY UNSIGNED BY EMPLOYEE THAT WAS PRESENT.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: PIC HAD EMPLOYEE SIGN POLICY.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: OBSERVED UNCOVERED MUG OF COFFEE ON FOOD PREP COUNTER WITH FOOD PRESENT. OBSERVED NO CFM AT THE BEGINNING OF THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CDI: MUG REMOVED AND PIC RE-EDUCATED. 2 46.37(a)-(h) - Certified Food Manager, Certification Process CDI: CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE GET MORE EMPLOYEES CERTIFIED IF ONE CANNOT BE PRESENT AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED A PLASTIC CUP IN THE HANDWASHING SINK NEAR THE COKE COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: CUP REMOVED AND PIC RE-EDUCATED ON HANDWASHING SINK USEAGE.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO HANDWASHING SOAP AT THE HANDWASHING SINK ADJACENT TO THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: SOAP DISPENSER FILLED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED ON STOVE: BLACK BEANS AT 125F (30MIN), RED BEANS AT 121F (30MIN) OBSERVED IN HOT CABINET: STEAK 1 AT 126F (30MIN), STEAK 2 AT 126F (30MIN), STEAK 3 AT 110F (30MIN) OBSERVED IN STEAM TABLE: STEAK AT 126F (30MIN), COOKED VEGETABLES AT 129F (5MIN)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: ALL ITEMS LISTED ABOVE WERE OBSERVED REHEATED TO 165F OR ABOVE DURING THE INSPECTION (SEE FOOD TEMPERATURES). PIC RE- EDUCATED EMPLOYEES ON REHEATING.

violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Pic removed the sanitizer buckets

violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Pic replace the handwashing soap

violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC agreed to replace poster

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed that the end caps are missing from the protective light covering of fluorescent light fixtures in the grease hood
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. PIC agreed to repair or replace lightbulbs

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment during the time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. Follow up will occur in 10 days to verify compliance.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Handing throughout the facility were observed at 86F using a calibrated thermometer
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC contacted plumber to fix water heater and water. Temperature issues throughout the facility.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: observed in the one door prep top cooler on the front line no thermometer. One door prepped up cooler at the time inspection had shredded mozzarella cheese and cut lettuce inside of it.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PiC replaced thermometer in the one door prep top cooler.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. wiping classroom observed, not stored in sanitizer solution in the following locations on the prep top across from the walk-in cooler in the rear of the kitchen, on the cook line in the rear of the kitchen, and on the front counter on the expo line..
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC moved all wet, wiping cloths to buckets of sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed handwashing sink by the walk-in cooler and handwashing sink by the three compartment sink separating from their ceiling compound and coming off their wall mounting fixtures.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC agreed to have handwashing sink repaired by next inspection.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: front counter on the Expo line at the hot wheel was observed, not maintaining good repair counters being held together using metal flashing tape and plastic.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC agreed to have front counter at the hot wheel repaired by next inspection.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Observed quaternary ammonia test kit for the three compartment sink was soaked and had been entirely activated and was unusable
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. PIC replaced quaternary ammonia sanitizer test strips with a new kit.

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Observed temperature was 105°F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PAC contacted plumber to have water heater repaired so three compartment minimum temperature can be the minimum of 110°F.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The water heater / boiler serving the food service establishment is no longer operable. Observed one tankless water heater not working.
violations.corrective_action: Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the food establishment. At this time, a new commercial, approved water heater shall be installed to meet the peak hot water demands. The water heater shall be approved prior to installation. PIC called plumber to repair tankless water heater. Follow up will occur in 10 days to verify compliance. QDOBA MEXICAN GRILL (Inspection Date: 08/07/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. observed a unapproved y-splitter on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC agreed to remove the Y splitter from the mop sink. Follow up will occur to verify compliance.
